The isolated [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Gibbela]] was home to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''tree''' that produced [[Color/Legends|red]], spherical [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. The [[Plant/Legends|plant]] was cultivated by the [[Dazouri]], Gibbela's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, who supported it with tripods built from available materials. Several of the plants were crushed during an attempted [[Mission to Gibbela|colonization effort]] of Gibbela by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Those plants were later restored following the defeat of the Imperial task force.

==Biology and appearance==
On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibbela]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|black]]-stemmed [[Plant/Legends|plant]] grew. The plants climbed nearby structures, a trait utilized by<ref name="Tales" /> the [[Dazouri]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species native to Gibbela,<ref name="Hiding in Plain Sight">{{SW|url=news/hiding-in-plain-sight-star-wars-shapeshifters|text=Hiding in Plain Sight: ''Star Wars'' Shapeshifters|int=Hiding in Plain Sight: Star Wars Shapeshifters|nolive=1}}</ref> who provided artificial support structures from available materials. Its twisted stems bore a spherical, red [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Tales" />

==History==
[[File:Gibbela_fruit.jpg|thumb|right|Gibbela fruit in stormtrooper helmets]]
On isolated Gibbela, a primitive [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Tales" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the native [[Changeling/Legends|polymorphic]] species cultivated fruit-producing trees. Groups of two to three plants were grouped together underneath a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] tripod tied together with yellow cord. In concentric circles ringing these tripods, the farmers grew a short [[Unidentified Gibbela crop plant|plant]] that produced a yellow crop. The farmers utilized [[Scarecrow/Legends|scarecrows]] to protect the plants, and collected the red fruits in woven baskets.<ref name="Tales" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] considered Gibbela an attractive site for colonization, following initial [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] suggesting the local population incapable of mounting significant resistance.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|340|Gibbela}}</ref> A small Imperial task force [[Mission to Gibbela|landed]] on the planet, and claimed it as Imperial territory in the name of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. That brazen act was achieved by landing their [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] on top of several fruit trees and crops circles. Retaliation from a local [[Unidentified Dazouri farmer|farmer]] ensued, and he [[Death/Legends|killed]] the entire Imperial task force. Following this incident, leftover Imperial equipment was converted to agricultural use: Imperial [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] were used to construct tripod supports and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]] were used as baskets to collect fruit.<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Ken Lizzl]] and [[Lucas Marangon]] created the fruit tree for the two-page [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], "[[The Value of Proper Intelligence to Any Successful Military Campaign is Not to Be Underestimated]]," originally published in [[Star Wars Tales 19|''Star Wars Tales'' 19]]. Originally considered to be [[Canon|S-canon]] along with the rest of volumes [[Star Wars Tales 1|one]] to [[Star Wars Tales 20|twenty]] of ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'', the comic was referenced in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]], which elevated its status to C-canon.<ref name="Canon">{{Blog|holocron|56|starwars.com forum HolocronKeeper comments archive}}</ref><ref name="CSWE" />
